capabilities: open a style menu by clicking an unchecked task checkbox
apply text effects (strikethrough, bold, color) matched to checkbox styles
toggle extra style sections such as priority, status, flags and seasons
turn images in a vault folder into custom checkbox styles
uncheck all tasks in the current note, with undo
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only changes how checkboxes look and which Markdown character they store, leaving tasks as plain Markdown.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that Tasks and Dataview may not count styled tasks as completed, and that themes with their own checkbox icons may override some styles.
problem: Obsidian tasks only offer a plain checked/unchecked checkbox, with no visual variety or per-task markers like priority or status.
summary: Task checkbox styler that opens a click menu with 29 checkbox and icon styles, optional themed sections, and custom image styles.
